findings.issue: kana reads 一月 as いちがつ (= January), but the sentence, en/pt and both expl fields all state the duration sense 'one month' (ひとつき). The transcription teaches the wrong reading for this context.
findings.current: いちがつでひらがなをおぼえました
findings.suggested: ひとつきでひらがなをおぼえました

findings.issue: Token 一 read いち, but in the duration word 一月 (ひとつき) intended here it is ひと; contradicts expl_en/expl_pt which explicitly say ひとつき.
Token 月 read がつ (month-name reading, as in January), but the intended duration reading is つき (一月 = ひとつき); the token's own gloss even says 'duration, ひとつき'.
Romaji follows the wrong いちがつ (January) reading instead of the intended duration reading ひとつき.

Generated JP writes the duration as 一月, which defaults to the January reading and is ambiguous for learners; natives normally write 一ヶ月で or ひと月で for 'in one month'. Rewriting the jp would also resolve the kana/token reading conflict.
findings.current: 一月でひらがなを覚えました
findings.suggested: 一ヶ月でひらがなを覚えました

findings.issue: Plain dictionary-form statement 見る is rendered as an English imperative addressed to the listener ('Look ... your phone'), changing the speech act; JP is a plain statement/citation, not a command (that would be 見て/見ろ). pt correctly uses a citation infinitive.
findings.current: Look at the map on your phone.
findings.suggested: I look at the map on my phone.

findings.issue: Duplicate tokenization: null-glossed fragments ガソリン and スタンド (tokens 0-1) coexist with the merged token ガソリンスタンド (token 2), so concatenating token surfaces double-counts the word and no longer reconstructs the sentence.
findings.current: ガソリン + スタンド + ガソリンスタンド + で + 車 + を + 止め + た
findings.suggested: ガソリンスタンド + で + 車 + を + 止め + た (remove fragment tokens 0-1)

findings.issue: Duplicate tokenization: null-glossed fragments 土曜/日/日曜/日 (tokens 0-3) precede the merged tokens 土曜日 and 日曜日, so token-surface concatenation duplicates both weekday words and breaks sentence reconstruction/ordering.
findings.current: 土曜 + 日 + 日曜 + 日 + 土曜日 + また + は + 日曜日 + に + 行き + ます
findings.suggested: 土曜日 + また + は + 日曜日 + に + 行き + ます (remove fragment tokens 0-3)

findings.issue: 'Quanto ao no mundo' is ungrammatical Portuguese (stacked contractions ao + no). The には literal device elsewhere in the bank uses 'Quanto à/ao X' (cf. sent:gen-220a8de73bc7).
findings.current: Quanto ao no mundo, existem várias centenas de milhões de pessoas.
findings.suggested: Quanto ao mundo, existem várias centenas de milhões de pessoas.

findings.issue: Missing space before the parenthesis: 'de dia(土曜日'.
findings.current: Duas opções de dia(土曜日 'sábado' e 日曜日 'domingo') são unidas por または
findings.suggested: Duas opções de dia (土曜日 'sábado' e 日曜日 'domingo') são unidas por または

findings.issue: なんおく romanized without a syllabic-n separator: 'nanokunin' is letter-identical to なのくにん and misparses as na-no-ku-nin; Hepburn requires an apostrophe after ん before a vowel.
'not that new' reads as a degree statement (somewhat new but not very), while 新しくはない plainly denies newness with contrastive は; the literal mirror introduces a meaning the JP does not have.
findings.current: As for this book, it's not that new.
findings.suggested: As for this book, new — it is not.

findings.issue: 'vaccine' is not a sense of 注射 (injection/the act of injecting; vaccine = ワクチン/予防接種); the gloss overreaches.
'vacina' is not a sense of 注射; 注射 é a injeção (o ato de injetar), não a vacina.
